assertions.subject: Hemangioma
assertions.quote: Ulceration is the most common complication and occurs in up to 10% of cases

assertions.subject: Hemangioma
assertions.quote: Ophthalmologic complications include amblyopia, astigmatism, myopia, retrobulbar involvement and tear duct obstruction

assertions.subject: Hemangioma
assertions.quote: Airway obstruction can be seen in nasal, subglottic and laryngeal passages

assertions.subject: Hemangioma
assertions.quote: Difficulties feeding can be seen with perioral or lip hemangiomas

assertions.subject: Hemangioma
assertions.quote: Visceral hemangiomatosis, especially multifocal hemangiomas (greater than or equal to 5 skin lesions), may be associated with liver or gastrointestinal involvement

assertions.subject: Hemangioma
assertions.quote: Cosmetic disfigurement can be seen with large facial area involvement or involvement of the nasal tip (called Cyrano nose), ears and perioral area

assertions.subject: PHACES syndrome
assertions.quote: PHACES syndrome manifests with a large segmental facial hemangioma (greater than or equal to 5 cm)

assertions.subject: LUMBAR syndrome
assertions.quote: LUMBAR syndrome manifests with lumbosacral hemangiomas and may be associated with underlying developmental anomalies
